description:
SYNONYM of get_offering, kept for agents that already know this name. A «product» is just an offering whose kind is `product`; the same id works in both.

Free. One offering in full, with ONE live request to the shop asking for that item’s price and stock
right now (`live_check`). Call it before you quote a price to a person: a catalogue read yesterday is
yesterday’s price. One business is asked at most once every ten minutes however many of its offerings
you open, so walking a shop is one request and not twenty; `from_cache` and `checked_at` say which.
A price list, a menu or a quote form has no single-item door to ask (`ok: false` with the reason) and
the stored reading stands with its date.

Hand `action_url` to the user as it is, ref=versum included.
name: get_product
title: One thing in full (synonym of get_offering)
